meta.title: Property Film Studio | Real Estate Video & Visual Content
meta.description: Premium real estate video, photography, drone and social media content for property professionals in Braga, Guimarães and Porto, Portugal.

hero.headline: Make your property impossible to ignore.
hero.body: We create property films, social media videos and visual content designed to showcase what makes each property worth seeing.

walkthrough.title: Luxury Villa — Bom Jesus, Braga
walkthrough.description: A cinematic property film created to highlight the architecture, privacy, outdoor scale and privileged location of this villa.

aerial.label: Aerial
aerial.heading: Location, scale and privacy from above.
aerial.body: An aerial perspective designed to communicate the property's scale, surroundings and relationship with Braga.

social.label: Social Content
social.heading: Built for attention. Designed for social.
social.body: A vertical video designed to capture attention and showcase the property's strongest selling points quickly and effectively.

items.title: Cinematic Walkthrough
items.body: Cinematic property films designed to present the architecture, atmosphere, layout and strongest selling points of a property.

items.title: Aerial Drone Video
items.body: Aerial footage that communicates location, scale, architecture, landscape and the property's relationship with its surroundings.

items.title: Agent-Led Branding
items.body: On-camera property presentations and social content that help agents build a stronger personal brand while showcasing their listings.

items.title: Social Media Reels
items.body: Short-form vertical videos created for Instagram and TikTok, with strong hooks, pacing and visual storytelling.

items.title: Premium Photography
items.body: Polished, editorial-style photography for property listings, websites and social media.

why.heading: We don't just show properties. We make people want to see them.
why.body: A great property deserves more than a sequence of rooms. We identify what makes each property special and turn those strengths into content designed to capture attention, communicate value and make potential buyers want to see it in person.

principles.title: Strategy
principles.body: We start with the selling points. Before we shoot, we identify what makes the property different and build the content around those strengths.

principles.title: Attention
principles.body: A strong video needs to work in the first few seconds. We create content designed around how people actually consume Instagram, TikTok and other social platforms.

principles.title: Quality
principles.body: Composition, movement, sound, colour and editing work together to elevate the property without making it look artificial or misleading.

steps.title: Plan
steps.body: We identify the property's strongest selling points and define the visual direction.

steps.title: Production
steps.body: We capture video, photography, drone footage and agent content.

steps.title: Post-Production
steps.body: Editing, music, colour, pacing and social media optimisation.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.body: Ready-to-publish content delivered for listings and social channels.

about.heading: About Me
about.paragraph1: I'm Aykut Soyuk, a videographer and content creator based in Braga.
about.paragraph2: For the past 4+ years, I've been creating video content for YouTube, Instagram and TikTok, handling both production and editing myself. I'm now bringing that experience into real estate, creating visual content that helps properties and agents stand out online.
